show.title: Farsh se Arsh - Ek Udaan
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/78w9Tr
show.description: A powerful heir returns to his roots and is mistaken for a poor laborer, facing humiliation from those who value status over humanity. As his true identity is revealed, he rises to reclaim his dignity, reunite with his family, and expose deep-rooted class prejudice.
